en-US.title: Logitech MX Master 3S Mouse updated after 3 years: It's actually changed quite a bit. But what ab...
en-US.description:
Logitech has released the MX Master 3S, the successor to the MX Master 3, after three years. Many of you have likely been waiting for the next generation of the product, as the MX Master 3 had some shortcomings, such as scroll wheel jamming. However, after using the MX Master 3S myself, I found it to be a somewhat ambiguous product; there weren't many new features, nor were the flaws of the past completely resolved.

In this video, we examine the first impressions of the MX Master 3S mouse, the changes made, and a test regarding the scroll wheel jamming issue, along with whether it is a product worth purchasing.
